definitions.explanation: Working the rudder to steer a boat or ship, or the person who does it.
Figuratively, directing the course of a company, government or other organization, especially through difficult times. Common in news and business writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舵取|かじと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{舵取|かじと}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}した→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧。
examples.english: Steering was hard in the strong wind.

notes:
Composed of {舵|かじ} (rudder, helm) and ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (taking, handling). The figurative sense is now the more common one, typically with an adjective such as ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ or ⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧な.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {舵取|かじと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to steer; to guide
- {舵取|かじと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}う→担う：12787_ninau⟧ / {任|まか}される: to take on / be entrusted with the helm
- ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧{舵取|かじと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られる→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: to face a difficult balancing act
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{舵取|かじと}り: steering a company's management

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {舵|かじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to steer — the verb phrase, used the same two ways
- {舵取|かじと}り⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: the person at the helm, the leader
